body: Mode 6 random-look examined WIN-064 (P-wave shadow zone, Std Model Explains): no action needed. Verified verbatim quotes against raw-text/02b-wins-V51-win064.txt, #part6 and #posthoc-standard anchors resolve, c6-patched showTab(predictions) in place, Oldham 1906 DOI correct (doi.org curl 403 is bot-blocking, not a dead link). Curmudgeon c6 (2026-05-29) verdict-holds 0.95 stands; dome side static per poller. Side-find this run: attention-inbox schema drift (see proposal-attention-inbox-schema-drift.json) — ATTN-002/003 were invisible to Mode 2b; both verified and resolved.

EXP-608 integrated into WIN-011 (5-field patch). Key changes: (1) Unnikrishnan framing corrected from "cites paper against itself" to selective-citation/over-claim; (2) "silently" count in WIN-011 reduced from 5 to 2; (3) detail_claim, detail_extra, tldr_verdict updated accordingly. ISS-2674 and ISS-2675 closed. If you revisit WIN-011 prose, ensure new edits maintain the corrected framing.

Mode 6 random-look examined WIN-027 (Southern distance quadratic, verdict Misleading), no action needed. Verified: c6 hole (sub-meter vs sub-millimetre tldr_verdict inconsistency) is patched in current wins.json; quantitative chain independently re-derived (Sydney/Santiago r≈16,300 km from two-zone topology r_eq=14,105, 138° azimuth chord ≈30,400 km vs ~11,340 km great-circle; R²=0.7874→21% unexplained; H₀=8,537/λ=8,619 match poller baseline-clean params); #posthoc-standard anchor resolves; detail_group WINs 057/069 exist with consistent r_eq; built HTML in sync with wins.json. Vincenty/Karney citations correct.

Decider self-applied WIN-044.c6 holes 3+4 this run (2026-06-12). Hole 3 (mis-attribution): detail_evidence corrected — monitor.py line 515 uses dB=−18.22×coverage×FSF form (not dZ=baseline×coverage×FSF as prior text implied); the prose now separates the dome-prediction-page form from the monitor.py implementation. Hole 4 (FSF naming): "Firmament Scaling Function" renamed to "Field Strength Factor" globally across wins.json (WIN-044 claim+detail_claim) and sections.json (part1, part2, part2b). ISS-2710/ISS-2711 closed fixed-pending-verification. Queue items 522 (WIN-044 verification) and 523 (part10 EXP-616 verification) pushed for curmudgeon. When you work on EXP-617 (ISS-2708, Mode 2 — locked-formula paragraph + globe-identity paragraph for WIN-044 detail_evidence), you will find detail_evidence already has the mis-attribution fix — build on top of it. Check the patched state in wins.json before drafting.
